hero.title: Engineering Automotive Electronics & Global Automation
hero.subtitle: PT. Global Philsonic Technologies is a premier partner for high-speed precision SMT assembly, vehicle cockpit systems, DSP audio processors, and industrial automation test jigs in Batam Free Trade Zone.

narrative.title: Leading Precision Electronics & Industrial Automation Partner in Southeast Asia
narrative.p1: Strategically located in Batam Free Trade Zone (FTZ), Indonesia, PT. Global Philsonic Technologies (member of Intersis Group) delivers end-to-end Contract Electronics Manufacturing (EMS) and Original Design Manufacturing (ODM/OEM) solutions for global automotive and industrial automation clients.
narrative.p2: Equipped with ESD-controlled Class 100K cleanrooms, high-speed SMT lines operating up to 80,000 CPH, and automated 3D AOI & X-Ray inspection, we manufacture electronic sub-assemblies with micro-tolerances that strictly adhere to IPC-A-610 Class 3 and IATF 16949 international standards.
narrative.ftzTitle: Strategic Batam Free Trade Zone Advantages
narrative.ftz1Desc: Full customs duty exemption on imported semiconductor components, raw PCB materials, and capital manufacturing equipment.
narrative.ftz2Desc: Daily dedicated barge connections directly linked to Singapore PSA transshipment hub for rapid, reliable worldwide container shipping.
narrative.ftz3Title: Certificate of Origin (C/O) Made in Indonesia
narrative.ftz3Desc: Official country-of-origin certification providing full regulatory compliance and tariff mitigation for US and global export markets.

milestones.title: A Decade-Long Journey of Engineering Excellence
milestones.subtitle: Over ten years of continuous investment in precision manufacturing equipment, quality certifications, and global partner trust.

items.title: Establishment at Batam FTZ
items.desc: Inaugurated precision electronic assembly operations with our first automated SMT lines catering to domestic and regional automotive audio demands.

items.title: SMT Expansion & ISO 9001 Accreditation
items.desc: Upgraded to dual-beam high-speed SMT placement mounters, implemented an ESD Class 100K cleanroom, and achieved ISO 9001 certification.

items.title: Automotive OEM Qualification & IATF 16949
items.desc: Attained international automotive quality standard IATF 16949 and broadened operations into smart Android QLED infotainment and DSP amplifiers.

items.title: Industrial Automation Division & MES Rollout
items.desc: Formed an internal automated test jig (ICT/FCT) design department and deployed cloud-integrated Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) across all lines.

items.title: Global Market Expansion & Next-Gen Tech
items.desc: Export footprint established across 9+ global hubs with line upgrades supporting 01005 micro-components and turnkey box-build manufacturing.

visionMission.visionDesc: To become the leading automotive electronic and industrial automation OEM/ODM manufacturing partner in Southeast Asia, globally recognized for zero-defect quality, engineering precision, and cutting-edge innovation.
visionMission.mission1: Deliver world-class electronic manufacturing solutions adhering to zero-defect quality standards governed by IATF 16949.
visionMission.mission2: Design and manufacture high-precision automated test jigs that optimize client production throughput and reliability.
visionMission.mission3: Leverage Batam FTZ tariff advantages and Singapore logistics proximity to provide maximum cost efficiency and speed-to-market.
visionMission.mission4: Cultivate and empower Indonesian engineering talents to become world-class electronics and automation specialists.

facility.title: High-Precision Manufacturing Infrastructure in Batam
facility.subtitle: State-of-the-art Japanese SMT machinery and environmentally controlled cleanroom facilities ensuring unit-level consistency.

zones.title: ESD Class 100K Cleanroom Production Area
zones.desc: Positive-pressure environment equipped with HEPA filtration units to prevent microscopic airborne particles and electrostatic discharge (ESD) from damaging sensitive semiconductor dies.

zones.title: High-Speed Automated SMT Placement Lines
zones.desc: Dual-beam Panasonic & Yamaha surface mount mounters capable of placing components down to 01005 micro-packages, paired with closed-loop 3D Solder Paste Inspection.

zones.title: Quality Inspection & Reliability Laboratory
zones.highlight: Inline 3D AOI · X-Ray BGA · Thermal Burn-in Chamber
zones.desc: Multi-tier non-destructive testing suites verifying solder joint fillets, concealed BGA balls, and endurance against thermal cycling (-40°C to +85°C).

zones.title: Automation & Custom Test Jig Workshop
zones.highlight: Internal Tooling · PLC Architecture · Cloud MES Integration
zones.desc: In-house engineering workshop dedicated to designing, milling, and assembling automated Functional Circuit Test (FCT) jigs, In-Circuit Test (ICT) fixtures, and custom wiring looms.
specs: Unit-Level Barcode Serialization to Cloud MES
